hotspots.title: Bullrich’s rebellion against Javier Milei
hotspots.blurb: Patricia Bullrich, Argentina's Security Minister, has escalated tensions within President Javier Milei's government by publicly opposing his directives, particularly over judicial appointments. Her defiance threatens Milei's re-election prospects and deepens internal chaos.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high-stakes power struggle within La Libertad Avanza, with Bullrich positioning herself as a potential successor to Milei.

hotspots.title: AfD’s extremism classification in Hesse
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces intensified scrutiny after being classified as extremist in Hesse, sparking debates over its influence in upcoming state elections. The party's leadership re-election and financial scandals further fuel the controversy.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the AfD's rising electoral dominance, moral panic over extremism, and internal fractures over leadership and finances.

hotspots.title: Magyar Péter’s EU migration pact protests
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar faces mass protests after agreeing to the EU migration pact in exchange for €16.4 billion in frozen funds. Right-wing factions accuse him of betrayal, while the government plans a media overhaul to counter criticism.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the moral outrage over the migration pact, cross-partisan accusations of betrayal, and the government's aggressive media restructuring.

hotspots.title: Lega’s defection to Vannacci’s Futuro Nazionale
hotspots.blurb: Italy’s Lega party is fracturing as key figures, including Domenico Furgiuele, defect to General Roberto Vannacci’s far-right Futuro Nazionale. The defections highlight ideological rifts over migration, LGBTQ+ issues, and Ukraine support, threatening Lega’s stability.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the Lega’s existential crisis, Salvini’s leadership challenges, and the rise of Vannacci as a disruptive far-right force.

hotspots.title: Trump’s NBA Finals politicization backlash
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump’s attendance at Game 3 of the NBA Finals sparked backlash for overshadowing the event and politicizing the historic moment. Critics, including NBA figures and politicians, condemned his presence as divisive.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the polarized reactions to Trump’s politicization of sports, cross-partisan outrage, and the symbolic clash over cultural narratives.
